title: Ingram Micro Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Vantex Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Ingram Micro Pty Limited proposed to acquire Vantex Pty Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: While the ACCC did not consider it necessary to reach a definitive view on market definition in this matter, the proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the "two-tier" distribution segment of the national market for the supply of IT products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the proposed acquisition does not involve the removal of a vigorous and effective competitor; and - buyers have the ability to bypass distributors and acquire products directly from manufacturers.
